command: env -u CARGO_TARGET_DIR RUSTC_WRAPPER= cargo build --locked --release -p fireemu --bin fireemu --manifest-path "$CUSTODY_MANIFEST" --target-dir "$CUSTODY_TARGET"
targetDirectoryNote: Cargo used an exclusive worktree-local target directory (target/custody) that held no earlier artifact of this build. The same command run a second time at the same source after hand mutants had been applied and restored (the files were rebuilt) produced the identical binary hash.
rustSourcesNote: The crates are those of sourceCommit; the evidence child commit changes only conformance and spec files, none of which is compiled into the binary.
reproducibility: Two builds of the same source in the same worktree gave the same SHA-256. Not compared across machines.
